geometry_stats.fitted_on: all coordinate training valid nodes only
geometry_stats.statistics_input: cached float32 geometry converted to float64
geometry_stats.neighbor_policy: exclude self/padding; include all kth-distance ties; use all when fewer than k

lr.rule: successful-update warmup then cosine, independent of VAL

classification.reduction: per-row valid-method mean times log(K)/log(2), then mean real rows

loss.ce_component: native maximin CE; diagnostic only for OVR arms A/B

checkpoint_rule: strict minimum full VAL macro_vs_sbs_pct with common new81000 TRAIN-fitted SBS; first wins ties
inference_rule: eval mode, original R77 maximin logits, stable ascending-global-solver-ID tie break
source_plan: common seed2 full18 natural stream; exact1024 rows, shuffled tails carried across cycles
gradients: real micro rows / logical1024; one clip/step; same subset and frozen EQL weights across AMP retries
train_eval: full TRAIN every5 VAL points plus the selected best if absent
test: one full TEST after unique VAL-best lock; saved predictions reusable
test_rnd_disclosure: TEST informed earlier R&D; preserved old holdouts plus previously unused input-stratified extensions
nss_reference: reuse R84 exact4500 predictions from locked R79 weights; validate population/pool/hash

objective.reduction: per-row valid-method mean times log(K)/log(2), then mean real rows

record.initialization: shared fresh R77 seed2 weights; no trained selector warm start
record.common_backbone: R77 instance/solver dual stream, score MLP, pair differences, maximin inference
record.common_objective: R77 comparison, relative risk and R-Drop retained

A_ovr_control.classification: replace 0.35 CE by 0.35 natural unweighted one-vs-rest BCE on raw utility
A_ovr_control.normalization: mean valid-method BCE per row times log(K)/log(2), then mean rows

B_gradient_balance.classification: same OVR as A with EQLv2-inspired per-problem/global-method weights
B_gradient_balance.unsupported_class_guard: use natural positive/negative weights until a positive classification gradient has been observed for that problem/method
B_gradient_balance.statistics: cumulative weighted absolute classification logit gradients, mean two dropout views
B_gradient_balance.transaction: freeze weights for a whole logical batch; commit statistics only after a successful optimizer step

C_cost_profile.extra: KL(q_nonwinner || p_nonwinner), both normalized over legal candidates except the saved native winner
C_cost_profile.student: softmax(final decision logits) on the same nonwinner set

D_candidate_subset.extra: mean native CE on two dropout views of an actual reduced-candidate interaction context
D_candidate_subset.subset: one uniformly drawn legal subset of size 2..K-1 per logical batch
D_candidate_subset.supervision: restrict original FP64-derived cost comparisons; exact ties use ascending global solver ID
D_candidate_subset.shared_encoding: reuse instance encoder outputs; rerun joint streams and original scoring for the subset
D_candidate_subset.transaction: same subset through all microbatches and AMP retries; advance subset RNG on successful step only
D_candidate_subset.inference: original full legal pool; no auxiliary branch

record.optimizer: AdamW lr=1e-4 weight_decay=1e-4; same cosine update schedule to 1e-6
record.checkpoint_selection: strict minimum full18 VAL macro_vs_sbs_pct using TRAIN-fitted SBS, first exact tie retained
record.formal_evaluation: lock one checkpoint and inference rule per arm, then complete TEST and both LIBs
record.empirical_screen: VAL macro Top1 increases and macro mean_cost/actual regret do not increase against the recorded comparator
record.mechanism_metrics: TRAIN/VAL true-winner recall, fixed target rescues, new false picks and paired cost changes

objective_state: atomic objective_state alongside model, optimizer, scaler and RNG
